name: Actress Scandal
source:
What is it like being the daughter of a famous actress? How does it feel to be the daughter of a man who was sentenced to prison? Dealing with all the rumors and judgments from people can be overwhelming. 

Recently a new method of defamation has appeared, how is she going to deal with that?

[From [url=https://azimiku.itch.io/actress-scandal]itch.io[url]]
translation:
有個當知名演員的母親是什麼滋味？而當父親被判入獄，身為他的女兒，又是什麼感受？光是應付旁人的流言和冷眼，就足以讓人透不過氣來。

最近，有人又想出了抹黑她的新手段。這一次，她該如何面對？

［摘自[url=https://azimiku.itch.io/actress-scandal]itch.io[/url]］
